person.name: Ricardo Maio
person.positioning: I build systems that let a business grow past one location.
person.tagline: Entrepreneur! Proud Dad. Getting Shit Done the right way vs the quick way.
person.summary: Ricardo Maio is a Cape Town entrepreneur who runs five companies across franchising, electrical wholesale, urban farming, business digitisation and food manufacturing. His work is about building the systems that let each of them run without him standing in the room.
